Source topic: transcript, regulation or glossary. Filter this before topic-specific analysis.
Document identifier; with document_type and source_position identifies the original text block.
Zero-based block order within a document. Repeated across chunks; select chunk_index = 0 to read each complete text block once, ordered by source_position.
Complete original source block, repeated for each of its chunks. Use chunk_text for a retrieved excerpt and text for its immediate context.
Complete source-markup question, when identified; null in regulations/glossary. Not a generated question.
Literal source speaker or section label. Not a verified driver identity; glossary labels can be Example.
Source section heading, when available; not a globally unique rule/article identifier.
Source PDF page number, when available; not the block ordinal or chunk index.
Parent document title identifying conference, regulation edition or glossary page.
Parent source URL for citation and provenance.
Parent publication date/time as source STRING. Publication time is not event time or proof of legal applicability.
Recorded transcript meeting association; null for glossary/regulations. Not inferred from passage text.
Transcript race label from the parent document; null for other topics.
Transcript conference type, including post-race. Null for non-transcripts.
Provenance of the transcript-to-meeting association; null for other topics.
Regulation season annotation; insufficient to establish article applicability at a particular race.

Source regulation effective-date string, if known. Current editions are unknown; never infer from publication.
Source regulation end-of-effectivity string, if known; unknown remains null.
Contiguous group of at most 120 whitespace-delimited words from the source block, with original whitespace retained.
Zero-based chunk within the original block; ordered chunk_text concatenation reconstructs that block.
Opaque search chunk identifier. The equivalent natural key is document_type, document_id, source_position and chunk_index; use these fields to locate the original text.

Text searched by semantic and keyword retrieval: full chunk plus bounded title/heading/question/label and neighboring glossary blocks. Context may mention another concept or person; verify chunk_text and original source.
Fingerprint of the chunk text, context and metadata. It is not a document or passage identifier; use passage_id for chunk identity.

Semantic representation as a STRUCT with result ARRAY<FLOAT64> (768 dimensions, text-embedding-005) and status STRING. NULL is pending; empty status and a 768-element result indicate success; nonempty status reports an error. Never aggregate vector coordinates. AI.SEARCH skips missing embeddings.
